51511024.protein: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3
51511024.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to STAT3 (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. The STAT3 SH2 domain (residues 500–600) was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4). Compounds were diluted in the running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted for 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding affinity (KD) was calculated from the sensorgrams using a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
